summary: GitHub Copilot Seat Management integration (soft-mock mode) verified end-to-end. Backend contracts, license GH fields, resync, reclaim, mock pill, GitHub activity column, and NewRequest github-username-input all working. Manager approve flow was pre-consumed by earlier iteration (Hiro already assigned before this run), so approval click itself was not re-executed, but its resulting state (assigned license w/ github_username=hiro-tanaka-gh, gh_sync_status=mock) was fully verified in the UI and API.
passed: GET /api/licenses returns github_username, gh_sync_status, gh_sync_message, gh_last_activity_at on Hiro's newly-assigned license (gh_sync_status='mock')
POST /api/licenses/{id}/gh-sync => 200 with sync_status='mock' and message 'GitHub integration not configured'
NewRequest form has data-testid=github-username-input with placeholder 'e.g. alice-park'
Ivy could reach /my-requests/new (github field present); Ivy dashboard shows a newly assigned Phoenix request (submission flow works)
/licenses (Priya manager view): Hiro's row (GHC-1003) shows 'hiro-tanaka-gh' username + 'Mock' pill in GitHub column
resync-btn-<id> present next to Reclaim on Hiro's row; clicking it fires info toast referencing mock/not-configured
Reclaim button on Hiro's row triggers successful reclaim toast (row/state updated)
/reclamation (Marcus): 'GitHub activity' column header rendered; empty state shows 'No candidates. License pool is clean.'

failed.issue: Only licenses that went through the new GH-aware assign flow carry github_username/gh_sync_status/gh_last_activity_at. Pre-existing/unassigned licenses (29 of 30) do not include these keys in the JSON response.
failed.evidence: GET /api/licenses => 30 items, only 1 (Hiro's GHC-1003) contains github_username/gh_sync_status/gh_last_activity_at keys.

failed.issue: Manager approve click for Hiro could not be re-tested because Hiro's request was already approved by a prior iteration (status=assigned). The post-approval state is what was verified.
failed.evidence: GET /api/requests shows Hiro's request status='assigned' with assigned_license_id set and github_username='hiro-tanaka-gh' persisted. Frontend /licenses shows the resulting row with Mock pill.

action_items: OPTIONAL: consider always serializing github_username/gh_sync_status/gh_last_activity_at as null in /api/licenses responses so the contract is uniform across all license rows (currently keys are only present when populated).
For any next test iteration re-seed a fresh pending request for Hiro (or another user) if you want to re-verify the manager approve click path itself.
